name: queens_n21__v2_nh
prompt:
Place 21 queens on a 21×21 chessboard such that no two queens attack each other. Queens attack along rows, columns, and diagonals.

Return a list of 21 integers where the i-th integer is the column position (0 to 20) of the queen in row i, or state "UNSATISFIABLE" if no solution exists.
